# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and engine updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 updates the bundled Skia engine and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages. It also adds Tizen 10 native build and packaging support, keeping the platform assets aligned with current tooling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia core fork updated for m155** — Integrates the current m155 Skia fork cleanup so applications use the latest bundled rendering engine changes in the 4.155 line. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — Restores discovery of system fonts when using the Linux NoDependencies packages, so text rendering can again resolve installed fonts without bundled native dependencies. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 native packages updated** — Builds and packages the Tizen native assets with the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain, keeping Tizen support current. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
